name: RGB Switcher: Color Roguelike
storyline: The realm once knew peace, but chaos has since taken hold. A mysterious corruption—a dark thought—infected the minds of the people, dividing society into those who loved color and those who despised it. The civil war ended in tragedy: the 'Color Haters' won. They erased all vibrancy, painting the world into a bleak void. Now, it falls to you and your fellow Painters to restore the hues of life, battling these Color-Hater Goblins and their creations.
summary: RGB Switcher: Color Roguelike is a fast-paced action-puzzle roguelike set in a dying black-and-white world. Players control a customizable geometric Painter and must master the RGB spectrum by manipulating Red, Green, and Blue switches. Through mixing colors and utilizing hundreds of ability combinations, players restore corrupted grid-based arenas while surviving dynamic, real-time combat encounters.
